home.name: Guo Yi
home.bio1: Over the past seven years, I've built e-commerce platforms, community forums, admin dashboards, and corporate portals, as well as mini-programs and mobile apps. I work comfortably across TypeScript / React / Next.js, Java, PHP, and WordPress, as well as C/C++ and network protocol stacks.
home.bio2: I prefer a practical, straightforward approach: thinking through business logic and edge cases early, and taking projects all the way from database design to front-end UI and deployment.
home.statusTitle: Open to full-time roles & freelance projects
home.statusBody: Available for remote or full-time positions, as well as contract work on websites, mini-programs, mobile apps, and custom business systems. Pick a star on the chart to look around, or reach out via the contact page.

about.metaDescription: Guo Yi: 7+ years of full-stack development across C/C++, Java, PHP, TypeScript, WordPress, mini-programs, and mobile apps, building forums, e-commerce sites, admin systems, and portals.
about.title: Who I am and what I do
about.subtitle: Guo Yi / Full-stack Developer
about.p1: I'm Guo Yi, a full-stack developer with over seven years of hands-on experience. Over the years I've worked on a wide range of projects, from e-commerce platforms, community forums, and back-office management systems to corporate portals, WeChat mini-programs, and mobile applications. What matters most to me is whether a system is easy to use, reliable in production, and straightforward to maintain.
about.p2: I don't limit myself to a single tech stack, choosing whatever fits the job best. For modern web apps, I frequently use TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue, and Node.js; for enterprise backends, content sites, or secondary development, I regularly work with Java, PHP, and WordPress; and when a project involves lower-level services or custom communication, I write C/C++ and work directly with network protocol stacks.
about.p3: Outside of client and day-to-day work, I jot down practical technical notes from real debugging sessions, keep a curated list of everyday tools, and occasionally tinker with Canvas and SVG animations. This website is where I keep my past project cases and notes.
about.fireLabel: Interactive campfire simulation: mouse movement tilts the flame with spring physics, click or tap to stoke the embers.
about.portraitLabel: Portrait of Guo Yi and his child
about.portraitModalDesc: When I'm away from the keyboard, I spend most of my time walking outdoors with family and enjoying everyday life.
